aboutpara: Hello! I'm Moisés Rodríguez Bolaños, a Full Stack Web Developer with over two years of experience building scalable, business-oriented web applications using React, Next.js, Node.js, and TypeScript. Experienced in designing and implementing REST APIs, JWT and SSO authentication, managing SQL and NoSQL databases, and developing full-stack solutions with a strong focus on architecture, maintainability, performance, and user experience. Accustomed to collaborating with multidisciplinary teams and transforming business requirements into clear and measurable technical solutions.

resume.description: Computer Systems Engineer with experience in end-to-end development of mobile and web applications. Focused on delivering efficient and scalable solutions, prioritizing user experience, with the ability to collaborate in multidisciplinary teams and adapt to new technological challenges.

experiences.position: Full Stack Developer at Abarrotera Hidalgo de Tehuacán SA de CV

sections.title: Summary
bullets: As a Full Stack Developer, I have contributed across multiple stages of the development lifecycle, from backend architecture and database design to frontend development and user experience design. I work on building responsive interfaces and integrating APIs, prioritizing clean code, performance optimization, and intuitive user experiences across all devices.

sections.title: Responsabilities
bullets: Design and develop full-stack web applications using React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, and PHP.
Analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable and maintainable technical solutions.
Design and implement secure REST APIs for communication between frontend and backend.
Implement authentication and session management systems using JWT and Single Sign-On (SSO).
Develop responsive, usability-focused web interfaces, prioritizing user experience.
Manage and model SQL and NoSQL databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB).
Document features, workflows, and technical processes to support maintenance and scalability.

sections.title: Challenges & Solutions
sections.description: Unify and scale authentication across multiple internal applications that previously managed independent sessions, duplicated logic, were difficult to maintain, and caused security and user experience issues.
bullets: Implemented JWT-based authentication, ensuring secure and consistent sessions across applications.
Developed a reusable client-side library in vanilla JavaScript, compatible with both CommonJS and ES Modules.
Implemented real-time communication using Socket.io to synchronize session state across applications.
Documented the library and integration flows, enabling easy adoption by other developers.
Improved the end-user experience by enabling a seamless single sign-on across all internal platforms.
